phases.objective: Accept ISO-8601 deployment timestamps that represent the same instant even when one representation includes fractional seconds, while continuing to fail closed on invalid or different timestamps.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A structured Hostinger evidence artifact reports production_merged_at with normalized milliseconds while the immutable workflow binding uses an equivalent second-precision ISO timestamp.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The bridge parses both timestamps, requires finite epoch values, accepts only exact instant equality, validates every remaining identity and side-effect assertion, and records the artifact classification instead of producing a false contract failure.
steps: Parse the artifact production_merged_at value with Date.parse.
Parse the immutable expected merge timestamp with Date.parse.
Reject either value when parsing is not finite.
Require the parsed epoch millisecond values to be equal.
Continue validating expected SHA, branch, domain, GET method, token-returned false, secret-free evidence, and false mutation side effects.
assertions: 2026-08-03T00:53:07Z and 2026-08-03T00:53:07.000Z are accepted as the same instant.
Invalid timestamps and timestamps representing different instants remain rejected.
The bridge no longer compares production_merged_at using raw string equality.

No Hostinger request, credential access, build creation, deployment, restart, provider mutation, repository contents mutation, SQL, migration Apply, database mutation, protected-ref update, force push, or external send is introduced by this change.

phases.objective: Observe a fresh authorized evidence run record a blocked or completed Hostinger classification when equivalent timestamp representations are present.
Exercise malformed timestamps, timezone-equivalent timestamps, and genuinely different instants while preserving fail-closed behavior.
This is evidence validation only and performs no provider canary.
This change does not deploy or mutate Production.
